title: Isoperimetric bounds for critical probabilities of disk triangulations
exact_target: Establish half-density site-percolation bounds for disc triangulations from isoperimetric dimension or boundary growth, with a strict bound under positive Cheeger constant.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000084 (AMR-099-0084). CC BY 4.0.

Itai Benjamini and Oded Schramm, \emph{Percolation beyond $\mathbb Z^d$, many questions and a few answers}, Electronic Communications in Probability 1 (1996), 71--82, Section 2, boundary definition, p. 73; Section 3, Conjecture 3, p. 74.
